content: Root cause: The boot failure on MSM8998 based laptops was caused by the enabling of coresight, which lacked firmware support on production devices. This issue did not occur on debug devices like MTP, indicating that the coresight functionality was not properly supported in the production environment, leading to system instability during boot. The patch disables coresight by default for MSM8998 to prevent this failure, enabling it only for the MSM8998 MTP where it is supported.
